prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Scope: offshore-wind acceptance, operations/maintenance, refurbishment/decommissioning; excludes beyond-connection grid/unrelated port operations. Aliases: Glassfin=Turbine Controller; Morrowick=Offshore Substation; Pale Lantern=Weather Service; Juniper Vale=SCADA Gateway; Thistle Crown=Maintenance Planning Engine; Amber Quay=Shore Control Room; Kestrel Bay=Crew Transfer Vessel; Sable Orchard=Fleet Dispatch Console; Mosslight=Warehouse System; Copper Finch=Metocean Buoy; Quiet Harbor=Cybersecurity Gateway; Blue Granite=Vessel AIS Receiver; Larkspur=Blade Inspection Drone.
Turbine Controller executes authorized commands within limits, reports state, produces Pitch Deviation Notice; local protection overrides conflicting remote commands. Pitch System adjusts blades; Converter Cabinet converts electricity with limits/interlocks; Nacelle Condition Monitor supplies health measurements; Rotor Brake Unit/Turbine Sensor Bus are turbine elements. Offshore Substation collects/switches electricity via Main Transformer; Export Cable Monitor monitors exports; Grid Interface Relay interfaces grid.
SCADA Gateway presents status/control availability to authorized Shore Control Room personnel; SCADA Engineer maintains interfaces. Control Engineer reviews alarms/conditions before commands; commands require role authorization/recording. Check availability before remote operation/after configuration changes; test permitted functions/prohibited paths after changes. Procedures identify access, alarm-response, restoration authorities.
Vessel AIS Receiver timestamps broadcasts; produces Position Quality Flag on integrity/confidence failure. Marine Coordinator uses traffic picture/Fleet Dispatch Console. Duty Planner produces Transfer Manifest Addendum for approved deployment changes. Vessel Master retains safety judgment. Weather Hold requires confirmed-safe resumption.
Blade Specialist plans Blade Inspection Drone coverage; reviewed imagery supports Field Supervisor follow-up/Maintenance Planning Engine prioritization. Suspend unsafe flight; observations cannot replace required physical inspections.
Metocean Buoy timestamps/retains observations through outages; validated observations feed Weather Service forecasts/Squall Window Bulletin. Weather Analyst advises. Require resistant sensors, thresholds, synchronization/health checks.
Crew Transfer Vessel transports personnel/tools; Daughter Craft transfers; Service Operations Vessel extended presence; Helideck helicopters. North Access Scanner/South Access Scanner/Personnel Tracking Console track accountability. Warehouse System/Storekeeper/Spares Hub manage supplies; Port Agent logistics; Work Permit Portal authorization; HSE Officer safety. Cybersecurity Analyst monitors; Cybersecurity Gateway requires default-deny, segmentation, authenticated/time-limited/logged/reviewed privileges; boundary loss restricts remote administration, preserves protection.

New part:
S149: Work Permit Portal is the controlled entry point for planning, reviewing, approving, and closing maintenance work.
S150: Work Permit Portal is referred to as Redoubt in this section.
S151: The authorization lifecycle begins when a work request is entered with its location, scope, planned duration, and responsible team.
S152: The requester identifies the equipment affected and describes the intended work in terms that can be checked against operating constraints.
S153: Duty Planner reviews the request for completeness and assigns it to the appropriate planning queue.
S154: Maintenance Planning Engine can use reviewed condition information when prioritizing future maintenance activities.
S155: Work Permit Portal maintains the request record and its revision history throughout review and execution.
S156: The review identifies hazards, required controls, access arrangements, and any operating coordination needed before work can proceed.
S157: HSE Officer reviews the proposed controls when the task presents a material personnel or environmental risk.
S158: Technical reviewers confirm that the work scope is compatible with equipment condition and the planned maintenance method.
S159: SCADA Gateway uses the deviation notice to flag work packages that may require technical review.
S160: Marine Coordinator checks that the planned access method and timing are practical for the work location.
S161: Vessel Master confirms that the vessel plan can support the approved personnel and equipment transfer.
S162: Work Permit Portal records review decisions and returns incomplete requests to the requester with the required corrections identified.
S163: Warehouse System produces a Backorder Exception Slip when a requested component cannot be supplied by the planned issue date.
S164: The Duty Planner resolves outstanding supply and scheduling issues before submitting the request for authorization.
S165: The designated authorizing role grants permission only after required reviews and controls are recorded in the portal.
S166: Approval is limited to the stated scope, work location, time window, and assigned personnel.
S167: Field Supervisor verifies that the approved conditions remain valid before the crew starts work.
S168: Any material change to scope, conditions, or timing requires reassessment and may suspend the current authorization.
S169: Work Permit Portal records the start, pause, resumption, and completion of authorized work against the permit record.
S170: The responsible team reports completion status and outstanding issues before the permit is closed.
S171: Juniper Vale shall provide current operational status to permit reviewers when requested as part of the authorization check.
S172: Closed records remain available for audit, incident review, and future planning.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
